changes_made.explanation: Added missing evaluation criteria from the paper, normalized method names to consistent capitalization, added semantic similarity retrieval method used for rule filtering.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - all evaluation was automated using LLM judges and specialized evaluators.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG evaluation through LLM alignment using value principles. It generates dialogue responses and evaluates them primarily using automated methods including specialized evaluators (ArmoRM, MD-Judge) and LLM-as-judge (GPT-4o). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of metric variants.
